title: Delivery contract — T3 PM job (rework, 2026-11-28)
body:
# Delivery contract — T3 PM job (rework, 2026-11-28)

**Scope.** IN: the PM request-to-plan path (`pm.plan`, `projects.baseline`), the dual-controlled charter, baseline and change gates, the change-request path with its impact block, and closure against the frozen baseline (`projects.close_request`, `projects.close`). OUT: project creation and the board surfaces, which belong to S05.

**Assignment.** Project T3 "PM job", issue #74, spec SPEC_V2 §12 T3; the manifest `acceptance/programme/T3.toml` is the gate, not this document; its checks execute against the live rows.

**Acceptance criteria.** SPEC_V2 §12 T3: "PM runs a request end to end; cannot approve its own gate; a baseline change requires a change request". The six PM checks in the manifest are the proof.

**Responsibilities.** The PM job requests and plans; the approver job decides every gate and is never its requester; the programme manager owns delivery; the architect owns the baseline's architecture content; the programme board reviews the tranche.

**Manifest.** `acceptance/programme/T3.toml`; the gate_checks T3-project … T3-rework.

**Retrospective.** Authored from the T3 Statement of Architecture Work and the manifest; the design is the PM job's request-to-plan and dual-control path. The board decision under the standing delegation approves this contract; the Phase-G review judges it compliant.
